skills.name: overall-review
skills.description: Interactively pick a base branch, pick a review profile (universal/bug-fix/feature/refactor/research/performance/security/migration/algorithm/docs), and run the matching reviewers in parallel against the diff. Outputs the findings as per-finding blocks.

skills.name: gitlab-review-comments
skills.description: Post /overall-review findings as inline diff comments on a GitLab merge request, with preview/confirm, per-run selection of findings (by number and/or severity), idempotent re-runs, and general-note fallback for lines outside the diff.
